name: 圆号鱼
evolution: 号儿鱼 → 圆号鱼 Lv.36
description: 会专门去矿物质丰富的水域，通过吸收矿物质来调整背部结构，达到调音的目的。群居，每天早上起来一齐练声，巨大的合奏声能唤醒周围水域的所有生物，喜欢安静的精灵们不愿意住在它们旁边。
descriptionEn: It specially goes to mineral-rich waters, adjusting its back structure by absorbing minerals to achieve tuning. It lives in groups and practices vocalizing together every morning; the huge ensemble can wake all creatures in the surrounding waters, and spirits who like quiet refuse to live nearby.
